messages.author: Luke
messages.content_text:
Yesterday I didn’t take a trade, was on my way home from work at 10am open. 

Only valid trade I saw was a short from 10am KO. Made new ATH, displaced lower and came back up into discount and got an entry from 10am with m1 SIBI. This was targeting unfilled M5 BISI and SL above 0.79.

More than likely wouldn’t have took this trade due to being at ATH and it’s very risking shorting at that height.

Definitly potential bearish targets, lots of Low resistance sellside and 00:00 hadnt been traded under. Definitely could have had a bearish bias for the day but still very risky especially with no SMT.

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
may 29 Notes:


I did not take any trades today and I tried to trade london at work, but there was just no setup that was good enought to enter off of. I missed the best setup of the day which was definitely the 10:00 short, which is unfortunate.
,
The overnight session kid of consolidated upwards, but then we got a huge pump up at 9:30 open all the way back to all time highs and our first bearish candle on the 5min after market open was the 10:00 candle, a bearish rejection block. The thing against this trade is that there are no other confluences because it is all time highs, but I think it works because of the over extension from 9:30 open and even securing a small 1:4rr would have worked here. It went a lot lower than that, but entering with that logic would have worked. (Screenshot 1)
,
That was definitely the setup of the day as nothing else really materialized after. I did end the month off net positive, but performance dropped in the last 2 weeks. I think the reason for that is performance actually hasn’t dropped, I just haven’t had the same trade frequency. Before, I would take 3 trades a week and usually win one, and now I take 1 trade a week which is why  I can’t get discouraged.
,

may 28 Notes:


Took a slight loss this day on a 10:00 short because I was offside for my bias. It was also the only trade of the week which is unfortunate, but still ok.
,
I was bearish going into New York today because of that unfilled nwog. That bias was incorrect because we were in a daily bullish fvg, but I thought the nwog would be a stronger draw. market traded lower off of market open and then at 10:00 we made a 5min, a 1min cisd, and then a 1min rb rejected those two levels so I thought it would be a good entry to go short. I basically got stopped out instantly because we were just bullish from that point on. Not too bad of a trade, what went wrong was the fact that I was very offside. (Screenshot 1)
,
A trade that I wanted to take, but didn’t was limiting the 18:00 open for shorts. This trade also got edged though so it wouldn’t work out, but the logic is still there. I wanted to see shorts and the 18:00 open which is also an ndog lined up with a 1h bearish rb and we had put a bunch of swing lows below it (el). This looked really solid, but I was too scared because it was too close to market open. Price missed the level by 2 points and then dumped to my tp, so still a good trade. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,
